title: Strong financials but the business is revenue cycle management only

input.facts: Billing and claims-management software for hospitals; the whole product range is revenue cycle management. Recurring revenue is 80% of sales. The share price fell 45% after a growth reset management calls temporary. No holder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: An RCM-only business is de-emphasized by the thesis: Radar. Not Reject (no kill criterion) and not Priority (the segment criterion is not met).
